methods.markPaymentPossible: async markPaymentPossible(checkoutId:string,paymentId:string):Promise<void>{await this.transaction(async sql=>{const row=one(await sql.query('SELECT checkout_json FROM pos_fiscal_checkouts_v2 WHERE checkout_id=?',[checkoutId]));if(!row)fail();const checkout=JSON.parse(row.checkout_json) as FiscalWorkflowCheckoutV2;if(!['PREPARED','EFFECT_POSSIBLE'].includes(checkout.phase))fail();checkout.phase='EFFECT_POSSIBLE';checkout.paymentIds=[...new Set([...checkout.paymentIds,paymentId])];await sql.run("UPDATE pos_fiscal_checkouts_v2 SET phase='EFFECT_POSSIBLE',checkout_json=? WHERE checkout_id=?",[JSON.stringify(checkout),checkoutId],false);});}

validateSnapshot:
(snapshot: RecoverySnapshot) => {
  if (
    !snapshot ||
    typeof snapshot.snapshotId !== "string" ||
    !snapshot.snapshotId ||
    !Number.isSafeInteger(snapshot.totalRecords) ||
    snapshot.totalRecords < 0 ||
    !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(snapshot.snapshotDigest) ||
    !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(snapshot.expiresAt)) ||
    Date.parse(snapshot.expiresAt) <= Date.now() ||
    !(
      snapshot.nextCursor === null ||
      (typeof snapshot.nextCursor === "string" &&
        snapshot.nextCursor.length > 0)
    ) ||
    snapshot.exactZEligible !== false ||
    snapshot.closeAuthorization !== "NOT_GRANTED" ||
    snapshot.completeness !== "RECEIVED_ORIGINALS_ONLY"
  )
    fail("RECOVERY_SNAPSHOT_INVALID");
}
